  semantic   0 error(s), 6 warning(s)
    ⚠ capability 'banking.generate-statement' has no binding — not invocable until one is added
    ⚠ capability 'banking.quote-transfer' has no binding — not invocable until one is added
    ⚠ capability 'banking.initiate-transfer' declares policies:[authenticated] but its binding never references a caller credential (${caller.…}) — invocation will always fail closed unless one is added
    ⚠ capability 'banking.generate-statement' (banking.generate-statement.capability.yaml) declares policies:[tenant-scoped], which is not enforced in this version — which tenant's data a call may touch is a separate axis from identity, and is deliberately not implemented yet
    ⚠ capability 'banking.list-accounts' (banking.list-accounts.capability.yaml) declares policies:[tenant-scoped], which is not enforced in this version — which tenant's data a call may touch is a separate axis from identity, and is deliberately not implemented yet
    ⚠ capability 'banking.initiate-transfer' is irreversible and declares policies:[rate-limited], which this version does not enforce: enforcing it needs invocation counting and therefore state — tracked as issue #45. An agent can run it as often as it is called. Attach a Policy document with spec.rateLimit, which is enforced, or limit it in the provider.
